intro.title: Small details, done properly
intro.p1: Straka Apartments isn't trying to impress you with size. It's built around the things that actually matter after a long day: a bed made up properly, curtains that shut out the light, a sofa deep enough to disappear into.
intro.p2: Warm oak, soft linen, and a living room that looks just as good with the fireplace glowing at night as it does in the morning sun. This is a place designed to be lived in, not just photographed.
